title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: Tenure Credit on a Manufacturer Copay Card Period Opening
content:
A tenure credit is added to the opening credit of a Manufacturer Copay Card benefit period of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. It follows the whole months from the date the program was opened to today: **6 months or more** add **200.00 dollars**, **3 to 5 months** add **100.00 dollars**, and fewer add nothing.

The opening date is the date the card enrollment was opened, as the enrollment shows it; only complete months count.

| Whole months from the program's opening date to today | Tenure credit added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | $0.00 |
| 3 to 5 | $100.00 |
| 6 or more | $200.00 |

*Hypothetical:* a card opened 2 whole months and 25 days ago adds nothing; one opened 3 whole months ago adds $100.00; one opened 14 whole months ago adds $200.00.
